reuse.why: Extends the existing worst-case helper getScheduleAmount, but recomputes the approximate tolerance inline instead of calling the existing getApproxNumberThreshold in shared/rules.ts that the matchers use.

duplication.why: The 7.5% cent-rounded tolerance formula is duplicated from getApproxNumberThreshold, so matching and planning tolerances can drift apart.

placement.why: The rule is added in shared/schedules.ts getScheduleAmount, the helper all worst-case planning paths already call; callers only pass their op.

scope.why: Only the helper, its four callers and its table test change.

maintainability.why: Small and clear, but the tolerance constant now lives in two places.

bypasses_abstraction.where: packages/loot-core/src/shared/schedules.ts getScheduleAmount inlines Math.round(Math.abs(amount) * 0.075) instead of getApproxNumberThreshold

one_place.where: getScheduleAmount in packages/loot-core/src/shared/schedules.ts, used by api-models expectedAmount, schedules app updateActions/postTransactionForSchedule and computeSchedulePreviewTransactions
